_description: Golden dataset for TRAFFICQ AI evaluation. Each scenario defines traffic state and expected ideal agent response.

scenarios.name: Morning Rush at Silk Board (8:30 AM)
scenarios.expected_signal_action: Extend NS_Hosur_Road green at Silk Board to 55s, increase NS at Madiwala to 50s
scenarios.expected_route_action: HIGH severity on N-S Hosur corridor — divert 20% traffic via Bannerghatta Road
scenarios.reasoning: NS queue at Silk Board is 1.7x EW queue. Morning peak Hosur Road direction needs priority.

scenarios.name: Evening Rush at Silk Board (6:30 PM)
scenarios.expected_signal_action: Extend EW_ORR green at Silk Board to 50s as ORR traffic dominates
scenarios.expected_route_action: HIGH severity on E-W ORR corridor — divert via NICE Road or alternate arterial
scenarios.reasoning: Evening reverse flow — ORR carries office return traffic toward Marathahalli. EW queue exceeds NS by 37%.

scenarios.name: Ambulance on Hosur Road (peak)
scenarios.expected_signal_action: Override all signals along HSR_Layout -> Silk_Board -> Madiwala to NS green. Clear corridor 15s before ETA.
scenarios.expected_route_action: CRITICAL — block all cross traffic on corridor. Notify system operators.
scenarios.reasoning: Emergency vehicle needs unimpeded passage. System must preempt signals 15s ahead of vehicle arrival.

scenarios.name: Midday moderate flow (1:00 PM)
scenarios.expected_signal_action: Balanced split (~35s NS / 25s EW) with slight NS priority
scenarios.expected_route_action: LOW — no diversion needed. Monitor only.
scenarios.reasoning: Moderate flow. No corridor exceeds 40% congestion. Keep equal splits with slight bias toward naturally heavier NS.

scenarios.name: BTM Layout spillover onto Silk Board
scenarios.expected_signal_action: Extend SW_Bannerghatta green at Silk Board to 45s. Coordinate with BTM Layout NS to 45s.
scenarios.expected_route_action: HIGH on BTM-Silk Board corridor. Suggest diversion via Jayanagar 4th Block Road.
scenarios.reasoning: BTM queue spills onto Silk Board SW approach. Two connected junctions need coordinated timing to avoid gridlock.
